title: TEDxTokyo — 人工知能の狭さ (The Narrowness of Artificial Intelligence)
description: TEDxTokyo talk in Japanese by neuroscientist 茂木 健一郎 (Ken Mogi). Argues that current AI, despite its impressive capabilities, is fundamentally narrow — it lacks the qualia, curiosity, and contextual awareness of human consciousness. Abstract philosophical reasoning and academic vocabulary make this genuine N1-level listening.
creator: TEDxTokyo
